productName: French Country 6 Drawer Dresser with Hutch Top
description:
Take nursery storage to the next level with the French Country 6 Drawer Dresser with Hutch Top from Old Time Oak. This magnificent piece combines six generous drawers with a beautiful hutch top, giving you abundant storage and display space in one stunning arrangement.
Six dovetailed drawers with full-extension glides provide room for clothing, bedding, and essentials, while the hutch top offers open shelving for displaying books, stuffed animals, framed photos, and nursery decor. The solid wood construction with signature French Country detailing creates a focal point that elevates your entire nursery design.
The lower dresser section stands independently, so you have the flexibility to use it with or without the hutch as your needs change. During the baby years, the spacious top accommodates a changing pad. Later, the hutch becomes a display unit for treasures and trophies. Non-toxic, baby-safe finishes. Coordinates with the full French Country collection.
